subject: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Carl Benson <carl.benson@skybank.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@skybank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 09 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance (draft)

Hi Carl / Emily,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the security/compliance gates we typically run for financial customers — SOC 2 Type II, SIG/CAIQ intake, DPA redline, and data retention windows for logs/backups. High-level suggested milestones below (draft):

- Week 0 (today): agree MAP & identify POCs (security, legal, procurement)
- Week 1: Redwood provides SOC 2 attestation + prefilling of SIG/CAIQ answers
- Week 2–3: SkyBank security review of evidence; follow-up Q&A
- Week 3–4: DPA negotiation and signature; confirm retention window (default options: 30/90/365 days)
- Week 5: Staging onramp & evidence validation
- Target acceptance: by 2026-09-10 (adjustable)

Can you confirm: preferred target acceptance date, who should receive the evidence bundle on your side (security POC email), and whether SkyBank has any non-standard items we should flag upfront (e.g., specific CAIQ sections you want prefilled)?

Attachments: MAP-draft-SkyBank.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestones and owners)

We can accelerate SOC 2 artifacts/attestation delivery and prefill the SIG to reduce back-and-forth — happy to coordinate a short intake call with your security team this week.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0129
From: Carl Benson <carl.benson@skybank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@skybank.com>
Cc: security-team@skybank.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance (draft)

Soojin — thanks for the clear MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Evidence required: SkyBank security will need the latest SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF) and a completed SIG/CAIQ intake. If you can prefill the CAIQ where possible that would be ideal.
2) Data residency & retention: production data must remain in the US. For logs/telemetry we prefer a 90-day default retention, with options to extend for specific workloads.
3) Staging: we need a compressed evidence bundle (PDFs + exported answers) and a staging instance for verification — ideally accessible by our security team for 2 weeks.

Target acceptance: current internal goal is 2026-09-10; if Redwood can deliver SOC2 attestation and a prefilled SIG within 7–10 business days we should be able to hit that.

Our security POC is Emily Zhou (cc'd) — she will coordinate the intake and confirm any additional evidence. I've attached our internal questionnaire template so you can see expected formats.

Attachments: SkyBank-Intake-Template.pdf (internal)

Carl Benson
Head of Strategic Procurement | SkyBank
carl.benson@skybank.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Carl Benson <carl.benson@skybank.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@skybank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance (draft)

Great — appreciate the clarity, Carl. We can commit to the following delivery plan: 

- Day 2–4: Provide Redwood SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF stub) + prefilling of SIG/CAIQ (Excel)
- Day 5–7: Upload compressed evidence bundle and provide staging access (limited IP allowlist)
- Day 8–14: Address any follow-up questions from SkyBank security; finalize DPA redline

Notes:
- Default telemetry/log retention we will set to 90 days for the initial environment. For customers that need shorter windows we can configure 30-day retention; for long-tail retention (>365) we recommend Dedicated or Private options so that retention policies and legal carveouts can be enforced at the tenant level.
- DPA: we'll start with our standard DPA and highlight the retention clause for redline. If SkyBank needs EU residency carveouts for specific data classes we'll capture that in the DPA addendum.

Can Emily confirm who on her team will intake the staging credentials and the best time window for access? Once we have that, I will route the SOC2 + prefills and update the MAP spreadsheet.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-attestation.pdf (stub), SIG-CAIQ-prefill.xlsx

Soojin
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Benson <carl.benson@skybank.com>, Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@skybank.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance (draft)

Looping in to confirm internal ownership. Team covenant: we will prioritize SOC2 artifacts and the SIG prefill to meet the 2026-09-10 target. Operational notes for the team: 

- Engineering will prepare a short-lived staging instance (ip allowlist) and a credentials handoff document.
- Compliance will package the attestation + supporting evidence (control descriptions, test reports).
- We will default telemetry retention to 90 days for this engagement; commercial impact if the customer requests <30 days will be flagged to Sales.

Aditya — please coordinate the DPA/contract timeline and confirm if a credit or expedited onboarding package is appropriate once SkyBank signs the DPA+SLA by the target date.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBank MAP: security onramp, evidence bundle, and target acceptance (commercial & DPA)

Carl / team — quick commercial note so expectations are aligned: 

- Deal: SKY-2026-87 (provisionally reserved capacity + hosted API). Pricing will be scoped based on retention tier (standard 90-day vs. custom). If SkyBank needs the 90-day default, we can proceed with standard pricing; sub-30-day retention or special custody requirements may change unit economics.
- Credits: if Redwood delivers SOC2 + staging validation within the MAP window we can offer a one-time onboarding credit applied at contract signature.
- DPA: I will send a DocuSign link for the DPA draft and SLA; legal can redline directly in the DocuSign packet.

Can we lock a 30-minute sync (incl. security POC) on Friday to walk through the prefills and handoff?

Link: https://docusign.com/placeholder/SKY-2026-87

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — confirmed: Emily Zhou (security) will be the POC for intake (emily.zhou@skybank.com). We accept the proposed MAP schedule and are targeting 2026-09-10 for acceptance. Emily will coordinate staging access windows; preferred window next Tuesday/Wednesday morning PST.

I've attached our SIG template and Security Requirements PDF to help your prefill and to highlight any SkyBank-specific asks.
